Container.Name: mcp-connectivity-test
Container.Overview: LAN/Tailscale connectivity test: one harmless hello_status MCP tool. No email, secrets, filesystem access, or host actions. Stateless Streamable HTTP at /mcp, health at /health. Runs as UID/GID 1000 with no storage mounts. Default publishing binds only 127.0.0.1 on the Unraid host. Before using a LAN/Tailscale IP, read docs/unraid.md and restrict access using existing private network controls. Public GHCR image supports anonymous pulls without a registry login.

Config.Name: Allowed hostnames and IPs
Config.Description: Exact comma-separated request hostnames/IPs, without schemes, ports, or wildcards. Add the selected Unraid LAN or Tailscale address here when changing the publish IP. Retain localhost and 127.0.0.1 for health checks. This is DNS rebinding protection, not authentication.
